help.title: Operation Logs (Level 2)
help.description: This view shows all actions performed by operators in the application. Unlike the Audit Log (Level 1) which records security events, the Operation Log records day-to-day operational actions.
help.whatIsLoggedContent:
• View changes in the application
• Alarm acknowledgments
• Recipe loading and execution
• Setpoint changes
• Data exports
• Process actions
help.retentionContent: Operation logs are kept for 1-5 years according to system configuration. This period is configurable in the Excel configuration file.
help.futureFeaturesContent: Currently this view shows example data. When the Alarms, Recipes, and Statistics views are implemented, the corresponding logs will be automatically added.
help.complianceContent: The Operation Log (Level 2) complements the Audit Log (Level 1) which is mandatory under EU CRA. While the Audit Log records security events, the Operation Log provides operational traceability useful for diagnostics and continuous improvement.

footer.level1Link: The Audit Log (Level 1) records security events
footer.note: Full logs will be enabled when features are implemented
